Construction Projects around Lakewood

Wadsworth and Morrison Road

Lakewood, in conjunction with the Colorado Department of Transportation, is starting a $7 million project to improve safety, accessibility and park access at the intersection of Wadsworth Boulevard and Morrison Road.

W. 20th Avenue – Vance to Teller streets

Lakewood has issued a bid for construction of a project to replace the traffic signal at the intersection of West 20th Avenue and Teller Street.

Traffic Signal Replacements

Signal replacement at the intersection of W. 8th Avenue and Simms Street.

West Calahan Drainage Improvements

Project elements include construction of new storm sewer on W. Calahan Ave. near the intersection of S. Quay Dr.

North Dry Gulch

The North Dry Gulch Improvement Project is a collaborative effort between the City of Lakewood, the Mile High Flood District, American West Construction, and Muller Engineering. This project is focused on addressing the chronic flooding issues along West Colfax Avenue. It aims to protect the local community, businesses, and city infrastructure by implementing effective flood mitigation strategies.

West Colfax Safety Project

To efficiently construct the project, a two phased approach for project design completion and construction is being implemented. Phase 1 includes construction of the W. Colfax Ave. medians and associated elements. Phase 2 includes construction of the curbside and street edge treatment.

W. 20th Avenue - Quail Street Park to Nelson Street Project

The W. 20th Ave. Stormwater and Sidewalk project installs sidewalk, curb and gutter, inlets and stormwater pipes on the south side of 20th Ave. from Quail St. Park to Nelson St.

6th Avenue Bridge Lighting Upgrade

This project is installing new projection lighting on all four corners of the RTD W-Line bridge over 6th Avenue.

Youngfield St. Pedestrian Crossing

Work has begun to install a pedestrian crossing on Youngfield St. near Myrtlewood Lane (adjacent to Abrusci’s).
